# Tools reference

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo run -p shin-cli -- docs tools > guide/src/reference/tools.md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool the engine registers (`ToolRegistry::with_engine_tools`), in registration order: 40 tools. This is what `shin-mcp`, a project run with `--mcp`, and the editor's Console offer. Arguments are one JSON object; vectors are arrays (`[x, y, z]`), colours are linear RGBA (`[r, g, b, a]`), rotations are Euler angles in degrees applied in X, Y, Z order, and entity ids are the numbers `entity.spawn` and `entity.list` return. Unknown argument names are rejected.

## `engine.info`

Reports the engine version, GPU adapter and backend, render target size, fixed timestep in seconds, and entity count.

Takes no arguments.

## `engine.list_tools`

Lists every registered tool with its description and JSON input schema.

Takes no arguments.

## `asset.load`

Uploads the mesh or texture named by an asset source, or decodes a sound. A mesh returns {"handle": n} and a texture (PNG/JPEG file or glTF image) returns {"texture": n}; pass them to entity.spawn as `mesh` and `texture`. A sound (.ogg/.wav) returns {"sound": source, "duration_s": seconds}; play it with audio.play or entity.set_audio. Loading the same source again returns the same handle.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes |  | Asset source. Meshes: "builtin://cube", "builtin://sphere" (32x16), "builtin://sphere-&lt;segments&gt;x&lt;rings&gt;", or a glTF path with an optional triangle-primitive index, e.g. "assets/x.gltf" or "assets/x.gltf#2". Textures: a .png/.jpg/.jpeg path, e.g. "assets/checker.png", or a glTF image, e.g. "assets/x.gltf#image=0". Sounds: an .ogg/.wav path, e.g. "assets/sounds/blip.wav". Relative paths are resolved against the project directory (the engine's working directory). |

## `asset.list`

Lists what the open project contains, from its assets/, scenes/, and scripts/ directories: one entry per glTF triangle primitive (kind "mesh"), per image file or glTF image ("texture"), per .ogg or .wav file ("audio"), per .scene.ron file ("scene"), and per .rhai file ("script"), each with the `source` string the matching tool takes (asset.load, entity.set_mesh, entity.set_texture, audio.play, entity.set_audio, scene.load, script.attach) and the file's path relative to the project.

Takes no arguments.

## `scene.load_gltf`

Loads a glTF 2.0 file (.gltf or .glb), uploads its meshes and base-colour textures, and spawns one entity per node with a mesh, at the node's world transform, tinted by its material's base colour and textured by its base-colour texture. Returns the new mesh handles, texture handles (one per glTF image used as a base colour), and entity ids.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Path to a .gltf or .glb file, absolute or relative to the engine's working directory. |

## `mesh.builtin`

Uploads a built-in mesh: a unit cube (extent -0.5..0.5) or a unit-radius UV sphere. Returns its handle for entity.spawn.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "cube" \| "sphere" | yes |  | Which mesh: "cube" or "sphere". |
| `rings` | integer | no |  | Sphere only: divisions from pole to pole (at least 2); default 16. |
| `segments` | integer | no |  | Sphere only: divisions around the equator (at least 3); default 32. |

## `entity.spawn`

Spawns an entity that draws a mesh (a handle from mesh.list, mesh.builtin, or scene.load_gltf) with a transform, a linear RGBA colour, an optional name, optionally a base-colour texture (a handle from asset.load), and optionally under a parent entity (the transform is then local to it). Returns its id.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | [number; 4] | no |  | Linear RGBA colour `[r, g, b, a]`; default white. |
| `mesh` | integer | yes |  | Mesh handle to draw, from mesh.list, mesh.builtin, or scene.load_gltf. |
| `name` | string | no |  | Human-readable name, shown by entity.list and saved in scene files; default none. |
| `parent` | integer | no |  | Id of the entity to spawn under; the new entity's transform is then local to it. Default none: a root entity. |
| `rotation_euler_deg` | [number; 3] | no |  | Rotation as Euler angles in degrees `[x, y, z]`, intrinsic XYZ order; default no rotation. |
| `scale` | [number; 3] | no |  | Per-axis scale `[x, y, z]`; default `[1, 1, 1]`. |
| `texture` | integer | no |  | Base-colour texture handle from asset.load (an image source), multiplied into `color`; default none (untextured). |
| `translation` | [number; 3] | no |  | Position `[x, y, z]`, in the parent's space when `parent` is given and world space otherwise; default the origin. |

## `entity.list`

Lists entities that have a transform, in id order: id, translation, rotation (Euler degrees, XYZ), and scale (all local to the parent), world_translation, parent id if it has one, name, script path, and audio (source, volume, looping, spatial, autoplay) if it has them, and mesh, colour, and texture (a handle or null) if the entity draws one.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | `100` | Maximum number of entities to return; default 100. |

## `entity.set_transform`

Changes an entity's translation, rotation (Euler degrees, XYZ), and/or scale, local to its parent. Omitted fields keep their value. Returns the new transform.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `rotation_euler_deg` | [number; 3] | no |  | New rotation as Euler angles in degrees `[x, y, z]`, intrinsic XYZ order. |
| `scale` | [number; 3] | no |  | New per-axis scale `[x, y, z]`. |
| `translation` | [number; 3] | no |  | New position `[x, y, z]`, local to the parent (world space for a root entity). |

## `entity.set_parent`

Makes an entity the child of another (its transform becomes local to the parent) or, with parent null or omitted, a root again. By default the entity's world transform is kept and its local transform rewritten; with keep_world false the local transform is kept and the entity moves with the new parent. Fails on a cycle. Returns the entity, its parent, and its new local transform.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `keep_world` | boolean | no | `true` | Keep the entity where it is in the world by rewriting its local transform (default true); false keeps the local transform instead, so the entity moves with its new parent. |
| `parent` | integer | no | `null` | Id of the new parent, or null (or omitted) to make the entity a root. |

## `entity.set_name`

Renames an entity; an empty name removes its name. Returns the entity's id and name (null when removed).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The new name; empty removes the name. |

## `entity.set_color`

Changes the linear RGBA colour of an entity that draws a mesh. Fails if the entity draws nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | [number; 4] | yes |  | New linear RGBA colour `[r, g, b, a]`. |
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |

## `entity.set_mesh`

Makes an entity draw the mesh named by an asset source (e.g. "builtin://sphere" or "assets/x.gltf#1"), loading it if needed. Colour and texture are kept; an entity that drew nothing gets a white one. Returns the mesh handle.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `source` | string | yes |  | Mesh asset source: "builtin://cube", "builtin://sphere", or a glTF path with an optional triangle-primitive index, e.g. "assets/x.gltf#2". Relative paths are resolved against the project. |

## `entity.set_texture`

Gives an entity that draws a mesh the base-colour texture named by a texture asset source (e.g. "assets/x.png" or "assets/x.gltf#image=0"), loading it if needed, or removes its texture when `source` is null. Fails if the entity draws nothing. Returns the texture handle (null when removed).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `source` | string | no |  | Texture asset source: a .png/.jpg/.jpeg path such as "assets/checker.png" or a glTF image such as "assets/x.gltf#image=0", relative to the project; null removes the entity's texture. |

## `entity.despawn`

Removes an entity and, by default, its descendants; with recursive false its children become roots keeping their world transforms. Fails if no entity has that id. Returns how many entities were removed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `recursive` | boolean | no | `true` | Also remove every descendant (default true). With false the entity's children become root entities, keeping their world transforms. |

## `scene.clear`

Despawns every entity. Uploaded meshes, the camera, and the light are kept. Returns how many entities were removed.

Takes no arguments.

## `sim.step`

Runs fixed simulation steps (each `fixed_dt` seconds) and returns the Time resource afterwards.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer | no | `1` | Number of fixed steps to run; default 1. |

## `mesh.list`

Lists every mesh uploaded to the renderer: its handle (pass it to entity.spawn), name, vertex and index counts, and source (an asset source string such as "builtin://cube" or "assets/x.gltf#1", or null for meshes added from code).

Takes no arguments.

## `camera.set`

Moves and aims the camera. Omitted fields keep their current value; setting only `position` keeps the camera's orientation. Returns the camera.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fov_y_deg` | number | no |  | Vertical field of view in degrees, between 1 and 179. Makes the projection perspective. |
| `look_at` | [number; 3] | no |  | World-space point `[x, y, z]` to aim at, with +Y as up. Applied after `position`. |
| `position` | [number; 3] | no |  | New world-space camera position `[x, y, z]`. |

## `light.set`

Sets the directional light and ambient term (linear RGB). Omitted fields keep their current value. Returns the light.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ambient` | [number; 3] | no |  | Ambient light added to every surface, linear RGB `[r, g, b]`. |
| `color` | [number; 3] | no |  | Light colour, linear RGB `[r, g, b]`. |
| `direction` | [number; 3] | no |  | Direction the light travels `[x, y, z]`, from the light toward the scene; `[0, -1, 0]` shines straight down. Must not be zero. |

## `render.frame`

Renders one frame of the scene and returns it as a PNG. With `width` and/or `height` the offscreen target is resized first and keeps that size.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `height` | integer | no |  | New target height in pixels; omitted keeps the current height. |
| `width` | integer | no |  | New target width in pixels; omitted keeps the current width. |

## `stats.summary`

Reports frame-time statistics over the last frames: mean, p50 and p99 frame time in milliseconds, and frames per second.

Takes no arguments.

## `project.open`

Opens the project in `dir` (the folder with shin.toml): replaces every entity, roots asset and scene paths at the project, resizes the render target to the project's window size, and loads its entry scene if it has one. Returns the same as project.info.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | string | yes |  | The project's root directory, the one containing `shin.toml`. |

## `project.info`

Describes the open project: { name, dir, entry_scene, window: { title, width, height }, input: { actions } }, read from its shin.toml. Fails if no project is open.

Takes no arguments.

## `project.new`

Creates a runnable game project in `<dir>/<name>` (Cargo.toml, shin.toml, src/main.rs with a lit cube scene, assets) and returns the list of files written. Fails if that directory exists and is not empty.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | string | yes |  | Parent directory; the project is created in `<dir>/<name>`. |
| `engine_path` | string | no |  | Path to a local `crates/shin-engine` to depend on instead of the engine's git repository. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | Project and Cargo package name: ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_`, not starting with a digit. |

## `scene.save`

Saves every entity (name, transform, mesh source, colour, texture, script, with children nested under their parent), the camera, and the light to a .scene.ron file, creating missing directories. Returns the path written and the number of entities.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | File to write, ending in ".scene.ron", e.g. "scenes/main.scene.ron". Relative paths are resolved against the open project's directory (paths leaving it are rejected), or the engine's working directory when no project is open. An existing file is overwritten. |

## `scene.load`

Replaces every entity with those in a .scene.ron file and applies its camera and light, loading meshes by asset source. On error the scene is left unchanged. Returns the number of entities spawned.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Scene file to read, e.g. "scenes/main.scene.ron". Relative paths are resolved against the open project's directory (paths leaving it are rejected), or the engine's working directory when no project is open. |

## `history.undo`

Undoes the most recent edit recorded in the command history. Returns whether anything was undone (`ok`) and how many edits are left to undo (`remaining`).

Takes no arguments.

## `history.redo`

Redoes the most recently undone edit. Returns whether anything was redone (`ok`) and how many undone edits are left to redo (`remaining`).

Takes no arguments.

## `sim.play`

Enters play mode: snapshots the scene so sim.stop can restore it, starts every audio source with autoplay set, then lets the simulation run (advance it with sim.step). Resumes if paused. Returns the play state (`state`: edit, playing, or paused) and `sim_time`, the simulated seconds since play started.

Takes no arguments.

## `sim.pause`

Toggles pause while playing (the editor stops stepping the simulation while paused). Fails if nothing is playing. Returns `state` and `sim_time`.

Takes no arguments.

## `sim.stop`

Leaves play mode: stops every sound and restores the scene (every entity with its id, transform, mesh, colour, texture, name, script, and audio; the camera; the light) and the simulation time to what they were at sim.play. Returns `stopped` (false if nothing was playing), `state`, and `entities`, the number of entities restored.

Takes no arguments.

## `script.attach`

Attaches a Rhai script (a .rhai file relative to the project directory, which must define `fn update(entity, dt)`) to an entity, replacing any script it had; an empty path removes the script. Scripts run every fixed step while playing. The script is compiled straight away; returns the entity, the path (null when removed), and `error`, the compile error or null.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `path` | string | yes |  | Path of the .rhai file, relative to the project directory; empty removes the entity's script. |

## `script.eval`

Evaluates Rhai source with the script API (vec3, quat_euler, time(), action_pressed and friends, math) and returns its result as JSON (`result`). Fails with the line and message on a syntax or runtime error.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes |  | Rhai source; its last expression is the result. |

## `script.errors`

Lists the latest compile or runtime error of each script that has one: path, line (or null), and message.

Takes no arguments.

## `input.list`

Lists the input actions (from the project's shin.toml `[input.actions]`) with their bindings and current values: `actions`, each { name, binding, pressed, just_pressed, axis }. `binding` is the manifest form: an array of button names, or { axis: [negative, positive], gamepad_axis }.

Takes no arguments.

## `input.set`

Drives an action by name on this engine, which has no keyboard or gamepad: `pressed` (true/false) or `axis` (-1..1), one of the two. The value stays until the next input.set; `just_pressed` is true until a fixed step (sim.step) has run. Returns the action's new { name, pressed, just_pressed, axis }. Fails for an action the project does not define.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes |  | The action's name, as in shin.toml. |
| `axis` | number | no |  | The action's value in -1..1 (clamped); at or beyond ±0.5 it counts as pressed. |
| `pressed` | boolean | no |  | Hold (true) or release (false) the action. |

## `audio.play`

Plays a sound once: an .ogg or .wav asset source, at a linear volume, optionally positioned at (and following) an entity so it fades with the distance from the camera. Returns `plays`, the number of sounds played so far, `playing`, how many are playing now, and `silent`, true when there is no audio output device (sounds are then counted but not heard).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer | no |  | Entity id to play the sound at: the volume then falls off with the distance from the camera and the sound follows the entity. Default none: the sound plays everywhere at `volume`. |
| `source` | string | yes |  | Sound asset source: an .ogg or .wav path, e.g. "assets/sounds/blip.wav", relative to the project directory. |
| `volume` | number | no |  | Linear volume; default 1.0 (as recorded), 0.0 is silent. |

## `audio.stop_all`

Stops every playing sound. Returns `stopped`, how many were playing.

Takes no arguments.

## `entity.set_audio`

Sets the sound attached to an entity: its source (an .ogg or .wav path; null removes the sound), volume, and whether it loops, is spatial (fades with the distance from the camera), and autoplays when play starts. Omitted fields keep their values; a new sound starts at full volume, one-shot, not spatial, no autoplay. Returns the entity and its `audio` (null when removed).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `autoplay` | boolean | no |  | Whether the sound starts when play starts. |
| `entity` | integer | yes |  | Entity id, as returned by entity.spawn or entity.list. |
| `looping` | boolean | no |  | Whether the sound repeats until stopped. |
| `source` | string | no | `null` | Sound asset source: an .ogg or .wav path relative to the project directory, e.g. "assets/sounds/blip.wav". `null` removes the entity's sound; omitted keeps the current one. |
| `spatial` | boolean | no |  | Whether the volume falls off with the distance from the camera. |
| `volume` | number | no |  | Linear volume; 1.0 plays the file as recorded. |
